summary: OXO, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce routine senior hires: Scott David Miller as Product Analytics Lead and Thomas Bennett as Data Science / Modeling Lead, effective July 2-3, 2026. The Company also mentions continuing evaluation of prospective independent directors and advisory board candidates. No transaction, special event, or strategic review is disclosed. This is a routine operational update that does not constitute a special situation as defined.
